articles.title: WBD Senate hearing: Netflix CEO commits to 45-day theatrical window
articles.mainIdea: WBD Senate hearing: Netflix CEO commits to 45-day theatrical window
articles.summary: Yahoo Finance Video: WBD Senate hearing: Netflix CEO commits to 45-day theatrical window. Netflix (NFLX) CEO Ted Sarandos is testifying before the Senate Judiciary Subcommittee on Antitrust on Tuesday, addressing the streaming giant's bid to acquire Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD). Sarandos answers Sen. Cory Booker's (D-NJ) questions about industry leaders' fears about the acquisition, the company's plans regarding the moviegoing experience, and more.  To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out Yahoo Finance. Related tickers mentioned: WBD.
